Neper looks progress

One widget set, five platform flavors in priority order (Windows, Linux, Neper, macOS / iOS, Android), each in a Light and a Dark look (docs/ui/looks-plan.md). Generated from docs/ui/looks/status.json and status.d by scripts/render_looks.py; updated 2026-10-15. 30 Delphi-equivalent controls and 16 platform idiom controls. A look with no status entry whose picture exists is shown as started: rendered from the platform palette, not compared with a real screen.

lightmatched
Audit 3: all 11 label cells match the live crops, 10 with 0 structural px off and 1 with a single px (a descender row of text, 191 levels); ink boxes within 1 px on all 11; the link hover and pressed grabs are pixel-identical to rest. Round 10: the disabled label is the native static control's #A0A0A0 (windows-native/light/label-disabled).

Neper dark = style.reference(.Dark) tokens, no platform branch. Measured on the 1.0 PNG with PIL (WCAG 2): text #E1E2E9 on page #121318 14.4:1, muted text #C4C6D5 10.9:1, field border (Border #8D909E) 5.8:1, focus ring / accent #B3C5FF 10.9:1, accent button label #002F65 on #B3C5FF 7.7:1, text on the selection row #39475F 7.3:1 and its edge #B3C5FF 5.5:1, disabled text 38 % = 3.3:1 (by design, WCAG exempts disabled). Group and list frames use OutlineVariant #434653 = 2.0:1, the same ratio as the light look (1.7:1): decorative dividers, not field borders. Every state of the label sheet viewed next to the light twin. Custom inks (a card's #33486C, the link blue #336CCC) are lifted toward white by style.lift_ink inside control.colored_text (Neper + Dark only) to at least 4.6:1 on the lightest dark surface, so the link measures 8.9:1; the hue stays recognisable but paler.

ButtonTcxButton → control.button
lightreview
Round 9: the DPI-scaled forms' ring is now the exact area coverage of the native ring at a fractional position (one pixel line at a third of a pixel; phases fitted per button: scripts/looks_ref_a/fitring.py), so every captured pressed, hover and focus cell of Options, Deck Properties, Deck Legality and About, and every crisp dialog button, shows 0 structural px off at 2 levels (max 1 level; button_states 38 cells, button_hover 28). Remaining: caption ink boxes of 3 hover cells (Open... 2 px wide, v3 hinted widths) and the disabled Edit Rule button's v3 glyph.
4 known gaps
  • Mismatch: caption ink of the hover cells Open..., OK and Apply of Advanced Filter / Conditional Formatting (left edge 2 px, text only); Edit Rule picture is v3 artwork
  • Corner arcs and focus dots of the scaled forms are a bilinear mix of the crisp tile (not structural); dots measured 13 levels mean error
  • Unverified: toggle, split, loading and plain kinds (no capture); disabled has one capture
  • Scale: 1.5x ring tile is uneven (informational)
darkreview
Round 10: the dark ring, face and focus rectangle are the native DarkMode button read from windows-native/dark/button-* (e.ui.winnative nring_*, baked by scripts/gen_winnative.py): rest, default (white ring), disabled (#404040 ring, #333333 face, #CCCCCC label) and pressed (#666666 face, #9B9B9B ring) match in all four 6 x 6 corner cells (0 levels off on cells 0, 1 and 3 of button.png), the line, shadow row and faces; the focus rectangle is the native one pixel dotted line (#CCCCCC / #131313 by (x + y) parity, 2 px inside the box) and a focused plain button keeps its grey ring.
4 known gaps
  • Unverified: hover: the native hover capture is pixel-identical to rest, so the #3C3C3C hover face is a guess
  • Not native-drawn: split, picture-only, picture + caption, toggle, loading and plain buttons keep the older drawing (native button-split-* and button-icon-* exist, not matched)
  • Label font stays v3's Tahoma 11 px (native: Segoe UI 9 pt), so ink boxes differ
  • The right edge of the dotted rectangle alternates by the screen x of the button (native 108 wide even, ours odd): parity may differ
lightreview
Linux infrastructure pilot: 8 kinds x 5 states (default, suggested, destructive, flat, circular, icon, flat icon, icon + label; rest, hover, pressed, focus, disabled) beside the real GTK 4.14 / libadwaita 1.5 crops (linux/button-vs-ref.png, reference left). Measured on the 35 cells that have a crop: 47838 flat reference pixels (face, ring interior, page, outside the box; the label and icon boxes grown by 3 px left out), 0 differ by more than 2 levels, worst 1. Face colours, hover and pressed washes, disabled 50 %, the 82 x 34 and 34 x 34 boxes, 6 px corners (arc corners, edge pixels within 2 levels at rest), the 1.86 px focus ring and Cantarell Bold 14.67 px (GTK's label width, 48 px for 'Button') match.
7 known gaps
  • Not within tolerance: antialiased edge pixels of the focus ring (up to 31 levels) and of the coloured buttons' four corners (up to 17); label glyph pixels (GTK hints Cantarell, Neper does not: ink 45 px wide against 46, 2 percent less ink)
  • Icon artwork is Neper's own glyphs (Add, Maximize), not Adwaita's symbolic icons (list-add, edit-copy); icon boxes and button boxes match, the pictures are masked
  • Label width is the sum of per-letter advances rounded to whole pixels, which stands for Pango's hinted metrics (kerning ignored); a long caption can drift a pixel or two from GTK
  • Not built: pill, linked, toggle (checked) buttons, the default-response ring on dialog buttons, osd and opaque styles; hover, pressed and focus are the library with state flags forced, not a real pointer
  • Not verified at 150 %: the library was rendered at 1x and 2x only (the 1.5x sheet is rendered, not compared); the 2x crops are not compared either
  • ControlVariant mapping is a choice: Tonal, Outlined, Elevated and Container are the default button, Filled and Default are suggested-action, Danger is destructive-action, Plain is flat
  • Cantarell is a TrueType conversion (scripts/linux/otf2ttf.py) of the OFL OpenType files, because the text engine reads glyf outlines only; Adwaita Sans (libadwaita 1.7) is not used
darkreview

  • Elevation is the Neper shadow (a hard offset, no blur) and no surface tint is drawn; the M3 tonal surface colours stand in for tint
  • No letter spacing (the M3 type scale tracks its text) and no ripple: pressed is the 10 % state layer only
darkstarted
M3 top app bar: small, centre-aligned, medium and large, with leading, trailing and overflow icons; scrolled container. The Material dark palette variant of the same sheet.
3 known gaps
  • Dark uses the M3 dark baseline tokens (surface #141218, on-surface #E6E0E9, primary #D0BCFF, secondary-container #4A4458, outline #938F99) and the same 8/10/10/16 % state layers; derived from the published palette, never compared with a device
  • Elevation is the Neper shadow (a hard offset, no blur) and no surface tint is drawn; the M3 tonal surface colours stand in for tint
  • No letter spacing (the M3 type scale tracks its text) and no ripple: pressed is the 10 % state layer only

Gaps: no Neper equivalent yet

  • Embedded browser (TWebBrowser / TEdgeBrowser): No Neper control; listed, not built, on purpose: the plan is to recode D:/repos/vaper into Neper later and use it as the browser control (maintainer decision 2026-10-16).
  • Chart (TcxChart / TChart): e.gfx.chart draws charts but there is no chart control with a Windows look.
  • Tray icon (TTrayIcon): No Neper equivalent.
  • Native file dialogs (TOpenDialog / TSaveDialog): No Neper equivalent; the OS dialog is used.
  • Image combo box (TcxImageComboBox): No per-item image in Neper's combo box rows; control.image_select adds it for the Windows look and is the plain select under the others
